statement: Linux v7.3 hid-steam uses controller feature ID 1 and 64-byte nominal report capacity for IBEX SET_REPORT/GET_REPORT. It performs attribute and unit-string queries on registration, applies lizard settings, then registers input, sensors and battery. A layered hidraw client's open withdraws native interfaces and its close permits them to re-register; raw close does not itself promise a lizard restoration write. Sensor open/close can send IMU settings. Kernel lines 435-665, 667-717, 880-975, 1372-1418 and 1633-1874.

applicability.revision: host sources Linux v7.3, SDL e0232c5 and 531acc, BlueZ aa4f5ce; device firmware not measured
applicability.scope: Consumer source evidence, not physical Bluetooth or virtual-host observation. Exact BLE GATT request bytes and physical reply completion remain unmeasured.
